subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should malformed workspace skill diagnostics be accepted as a dedicated `skills lint` command first, or must normal list/check/status/Web surfaces also show skipped `SKILL.md` candidates before this issue is considered solved?
rationale: Current main lacks any visible skipped-candidate diagnostics, and the open PR implements a narrower lint path while the issue explicitly requests normal CLI and Web visibility too.

options.title: Accept lint first
options.body: Treat `skills lint` plus docs as the first landed fix, while keeping list/status/Web diagnostics as follow-up work if maintainers still want them.

options.title: Require normal-surface diagnostics
options.body: Ask the implementation PR or a replacement to thread failed-candidate records through `skills.status`, `skills list/check`, and the Web skills page before closing this issue.

options.title: Pause for design
options.body: Hold the candidate PR until maintainers define the permanent skipped-skill diagnostic schema and redaction policy.

recommendation.title: Accept lint first
recommendation.body: Treat `skills lint` plus docs as the first landed fix, while keeping list/status/Web diagnostics as follow-up work if maintainers still want them.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work spans the loader/status surfaces that would need to own the diagnostic contract.
